purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks.

cases.prompt: ponder this codebase and keep thinking until it converges
cases.assert: Starts a coverage-gated multi-pass deliberation loop and runs passes until findings converge.

cases.prompt: audit and grade every screen and module in the UI without skipping the tail
cases.assert: Enumerates all units in units.json and enforces the coverage gate before stopping.

cases.prompt: run a multi-pass code review with skeptic and builder perspectives that retracts false positives instead of inventing pass-4 nitpicks
cases.assert: Runs four-perspective deliberation over an append-only ledger and halts on epistemic silence.

cases.prompt: format my python file with black
cases.assert: Does not trigger for a single formatting command.

cases.prompt: write a git commit message for staged changes
cases.assert: Does not trigger for commit message generation.

cases.prompt: rename the user_id variable to account_id in main.py
cases.assert: Does not trigger for a direct single-file edit.
